author: Animan
description:
Top 10 Most Shocking Anime Betrayals of All Time that changed everything. From Reiner Braun’s casual confession in Attack on Titan to the unforgivable actions of Shou Tucker in Fullmetal Alchemist, we are diving deep into the betrayals that fundamentally redefined the stories we love.

In this video, we break down why trust is so fragile in the anime world. We explore the tragic complex history of Itachi Uchiha , the cold-blooded envy of Rachel in Tower of God , and the terrifying logic of Kyubey. Whether it’s "emotional damage" or "absolute cinema," these are the moments that made us pause the screen and stare in disbelief.
